# Reproduced figures

These images are not generated by this repository's code. They are crops of figures from two
published WAMSI Dredging Science Node reports, made by `R/external-figures.R`, and they are not
covered by this repository's CC BY 4.0 licence. They are reused under the reports' own licence,
Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia
([CC BY 3.0 AU](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/au/)). Both reports state that all
material is provided under that licence unless otherwise noted, and neither figure has a
separate credit.

| File | Source | Changes |
|---|---|---|
| `porites-time-sequence.jpg` | Fisher R, Jones R, Bessell-Browne P (2019) *Effects of dredging and dredging related activities on water quality: impacts on coral mortality and threshold development.* Report of Theme 4, Project 4.9, WAMSI Dredging Science Node, Perth. Project 4.9.4, Figure 6 (PDF page 107). | Cropped to the figure; caption removed. |
| `porites-strip.jpg` | As above, top row of photographs only (days 1, 130 and 263). | Cropped. |
| `turbidity-thresholds.png` | Jones R, Fisher R, Bessell-Browne P, Negri A, Duckworth A (2019) *Theme 4 Synthesis Report: Defining thresholds and indicators of coral response to dredging-related pressures.* WAMSI Dredging Science Node, Perth. Figure 19 (PDF page 35). | Caption removed; panels A and B placed side by side rather than stacked. |

Copyright in both reports is held by the Western Australian Marine Science Institution, with
intellectual property owned by WAMSI, the Australian Institute of Marine Science and, for the
synthesis report, James Cook University. The research was funded by Woodside Energy, Chevron
Australia, BHP Billiton and the WAMSI partners.

Each slide that shows one of these figures gives the same attribution in its credit line. The
source PDFs are kept in the git-ignored `Relevant_publication_history_pdfs/dredging_reports/`.
